mainEntity.name: What should I expect during my first functional fitness class at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: During your first functional fitness class at Cave Training, you can expect a comprehensive warm-up followed by instruction on foundational movements and proper form. Our trainers will guide you through a series of exercises that combine strength, cardio, and mobility, adapted to your current fitness level. The session concludes with a cool-down. We recommend arriving a few minutes early to discuss any physical considerations with your coach so they can tailor the workout experience to you.
